about_the_game:
Conquer the galaxy in minutes, not hours.

Orion Wars is a streamlined fusion of 4X strategy and real-time space battles. Games last 10–25 minutes, with only two unit types to command—but thousands can clash at once. Every decision matters as you choose your path to victory.

Two Ways to Win

  • Total Domination: Seize every star system in the galaxy.

  • Singularity Ascension: Complete every branch of research and transcend the universe itself.

Key Features

  • Short-session 4X: Deep strategy that fits into a lunch break.

  • Massive real-time battles: Hundreds to thousands of units fighting across the galaxy.

  • Streamlined control: Just two unit types—but endless tactical possibilities.

  • Research tree: Unlock weapons, defenses, and the ultimate Singularity.

  • Replayable: Procedural galaxies, different difficulty levels, and alien opponents to conquer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060/ Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
